achievables.objective: Verify WP007J-R1 lineage, repository state, approved runtime, caches, resources and frozen SAFE-A.
achievables.hypothesis: The approved WP007J-R1 CPU environment and artifacts remain reproducible.
achievables.successCondition: Exact parent, open PR #851, approved environment and SAFE-A identity all verify.
achievables.falsificationCondition: An ancestry, artifact, runtime or resource mismatch prevents safe continuation.
achievables.experiment: Fetch origin, inspect PR/branches/worktrees, locate runtime/checkpoint/media/caches and measure RAM/disk.
achievables.validation: Independent GitHub and local Git checks; checkpoint hash verification.
achievables.independentCrossCheck: Compare PR metadata, local ancestry and prior freeze artifacts.
achievables.remainingUncertainty: External review may identify additional runtime or lineage questions; no execution blocker remains.

achievables.objective: Freeze rights-aware TRAIN/DEV/CONFIRM/RESERVE roles, source-family rules, encoder roles, gates and seals before scoring.
achievables.hypothesis: Independent source-family and encoder roles can be formed from approved material without leakage.
achievables.successCondition: Self-hashed protocol and role manifests exist before CES-S fitting or confirmation access.
achievables.falsificationCondition: Rights, family disjointness or fresh confirmation cannot be established.
achievables.datasetRole: All roles, including FLUX.1 diagnostic and sealed reserves.
achievables.experiment: Inventory approved historical media and construct score-blind manifests.
achievables.validation: Hash, duplicate, family, generator, encoder and reserve-boundary checks.
achievables.independentCrossCheck: Second manifest reader verifies role counts and disjointness.
achievables.remainingUncertainty: The bounded corpus cannot represent every future generator, encoder or rights regime.

achievables.objective: Implement and specify CES-E as deterministic codec/input-regime context without authenticity output.
achievables.hypothesis: Current codec facts and controlled lineage can be measured reproducibly and separated from origin claims.
achievables.successCondition: CES-E contract handles valid/invalid JPEG and PNG, emits facts/applicability/reasons, never AI labels.
achievables.falsificationCondition: Parser nondeterminism, unsafe failure handling or unavoidable authorship inference is found.
achievables.datasetRole: All controlled originals and descendants; no model training role.
achievables.experiment: Extend the inherited inspector with versioned contract and deterministic applicability states.
achievables.validation: Known-byte fixtures, malformed media, current-byte and history semantics tests.
achievables.independentCrossCheck: Pillow/Sharp or another trusted decoder comparison.
achievables.remainingUncertainty: Current-byte facts are reliable in the tested matrix, but historical compression and authorship remain unknowable without provenance.

achievables.objective: Build a Lythaus-owned CPU feature extractor for pixel, DCT, FFT, phase, wavelet/residual and codec-conditioned candidates.
achievables.hypothesis: A compact subset of deterministic features retains synthetic information after codec degradation.
achievables.successCondition: Finite deterministic feature vectors, versioned definitions, missingness and feature hashes are produced on real media.
achievables.falsificationCondition: Features are nondeterministic, unavailable, duplicate-only or unsafe under malformed inputs.
achievables.datasetRole: Development and later disjoint confirmation source families.
achievables.experiment: Extract predeclared feature groups from frozen source/descendant cohorts.
achievables.validation: Known-answer FFT/DCT fixtures, repeat hash checks and finite-value validation.
achievables.independentCrossCheck: Independent implementation or trusted NumPy/SciPy calculations on representative rows.
achievables.remainingUncertainty: The measured feature family did not yield a qualified codec-resilient specialist; future features may behave differently.

achievables.objective: Determine whether candidate features encode truth or merely encoder, format, quality, sampling, generator or source-family shortcuts.
achievables.hypothesis: Codec metadata and content features can be separated sufficiently for leave-one-encoder-out testing.
achievables.successCondition: Associations and ablations are quantified; dangerous features are removed or confined to CES-E.
achievables.falsificationCondition: Performance depends primarily on encoder/format identity or a forbidden shortcut.
achievables.datasetRole: TRAIN/DEV only for feature decisions; confirmation untouched.
achievables.experiment: Compute feature associations and predeclared codec-feature removal ablations.
achievables.validation: Family/encoder grouped statistics and permutation/label sanity checks.
achievables.independentCrossCheck: Recompute associations with an independent statistics path.
achievables.remainingUncertainty: Finite cohorts cannot exclude every real-world codec shortcut, but the unseen-encoder failure is a decisive rejection for this candidate.

achievables.objective: Fit the smallest justified CES-S candidate without modifying SAFE-A or using confirmation data.
achievables.hypothesis: A low-capacity linear model over Lythaus-owned features can recover codec-degraded synthetic evidence.
achievables.successCondition: Training/DEV results show predeclared incremental promise with stable features and acceptable DEV hard-negative behavior.
achievables.falsificationCondition: Linear candidates fail, overfit, learn shortcuts or require forbidden complexity.
achievables.datasetRole: TRAIN and DEV only; historical WP007J-R1 may be development-only.
achievables.experiment: Fit standardized logistic regression first; escalate only under the frozen rule.
achievables.validation: Family/grouped splits, frozen threshold rule, feature stability and seed rerun.
achievables.independentCrossCheck: Independent inference reader and held-out source-family DEV subset.
achievables.remainingUncertainty: The candidate has descriptive signal but fails the predeclared codec-resilient qualification gates.

achievables.objective: Measure CES-S encoder generalization without allowing encoder identity to become authenticity evidence.
achievables.hypothesis: A genuine codec-resilient specialist survives an unseen encoder path.
achievables.successCondition: Pillow-to-Sharp and Sharp-to-Pillow confirmation results retain useful signal with controlled source-level FPR.
achievables.falsificationCondition: Performance collapses on an unseen encoder or codec-feature ablation reveals shortcut dependence.
achievables.experiment: Run E1/E2 and E3 if a third approved encoder exists.
achievables.validation: Exact encoder manifests, no same-parent cross-role leakage, per-encoder metrics.
achievables.independentCrossCheck: Independent manifest audit and alternate decoder metadata check.
achievables.remainingUncertainty: Only the approved local encoder paths were tested; the candidate already failed the required cross-encoder test.

achievables.objective: Measure synthetic evidence transfer across unseen generator families, including Seedream-4 and Imagen-4 challenges.
achievables.hypothesis: Codec-resilient content features generalize beyond generator names seen during fitting.
achievables.successCondition: Held-out family recall and score distributions show non-memorization with controlled negative FPR.
achievables.falsificationCondition: Only seen families are detected or Seedream/Imagen require direct memorization.
achievables.experiment: Run leave-one-generator-family-out and C1-C12 challenge panel.
achievables.validation: Family-level split proofs and per-family metrics with Wilson intervals.
achievables.independentCrossCheck: Second scorer reads frozen model artifact and recomputes held-out summaries.
achievables.remainingUncertainty: Seedream-4 and Imagen-4 remain separate domain gaps; provider/runtime effects remain unresolved.

achievables.objective: Quantify CES-S source-level worst-case FPR on camera and diverse digital/hard negatives.
achievables.hypothesis: A codec-resilient specialist can preserve SAFE-like specificity on unusual genuine content.
achievables.successCondition: Observed FPR, Wilson intervals and subgroup behavior satisfy the predeclared safety gate or are honestly rejected.
achievables.falsificationCondition: Camera or hard-negative subgroup FPR is materially unsafe or confidence bounds remain incompatible with the target.
achievables.datasetRole: Fresh confirmation and reserve negatives, source-family denominator.
achievables.experiment: Score original and declared descendants, counting any high-evidence descendant as a source FP.
achievables.validation: No exclusions after scoring; independent FP forensic review.
achievables.independentCrossCheck: Wilson/AUC known-answer fixtures and second aggregation implementation.
achievables.remainingUncertainty: Population FPR beyond the bounded source-family corpus remains unproven; source-level candidate FPR is 0.837% observed with a 0.406%–1.718% Wilson interval.

achievables.objective: Measure whether CES-S adds unique SAFE-A rescue without unsafe induced contradictions.
achievables.hypothesis: CES-S errors differ meaningfully from SAFE-A under codec degradation.
achievables.successCondition: Unique SAFE-A rescue, induced FP burden and error correlations are quantified on independent data.
achievables.falsificationCondition: CES-S is redundant, harms correct SAFE-A cases, or cannot rescue compressed misses.
achievables.experiment: Compare SAFE-A/CES-S jointly without averaging or voting; evaluate SAFE-easy JPEG rescue and domain rescue separately.
achievables.validation: Paired source-level contingency tables and transformation/generator strata.
achievables.independentCrossCheck: Independent aggregation and frozen evidence replay.
achievables.remainingUncertainty: The tested candidate adds some unique numerical rescue but not enough safe, cross-family or cross-encoder rescue for promotion.

achievables.objective: Determine whether deterministic codec facts predict SAFE applicability without becoming authenticity evidence.
achievables.hypothesis: Controlled transformation lineage and current-byte facts can identify materially degraded SAFE regimes with bounded false downgrades.
achievables.successCondition: Frozen applicability logic reports supported/limited/unsupported/unknown with sensitivity, coverage and false-downgrade metrics.
achievables.falsificationCondition: The gate either misses destructive regimes or marks nearly all valid originals unsupported.
achievables.datasetRole: Controlled DEV and disjoint applicability confirmation; no CES-S truth fitting.
achievables.experiment: Define SAFE signal-destroyed outcomes from paired originals/descendants and freeze deterministic rules.
achievables.validation: Encoder, sampling, native-camera-JPEG, JPEG-to-PNG and compound-transform strata.
achievables.independentCrossCheck: Apply frozen gate to held-out source families and independent inspector metadata.
achievables.remainingUncertainty: The current rule is useful but over-conservative: native camera-JPEG support is not established from bytes alone and history remains uncertain.

achievables.objective: Qualify CPU latency, memory, artifact size, code ownership and training-data rights for CES-E/CES-S.
achievables.hypothesis: A small deterministic pipeline is practical on the approved Ryzen 7/16GB CPU environment.
achievables.successCondition: Runtime/resource/rights dossier supports research role and clearly labels any research-only model.
achievables.falsificationCondition: Unsafe resource usage, unclear training rights or non-reproducible artifacts block intended role.
achievables.experiment: Benchmark cold/load/warm latency, memory, serialized size and provenance.
achievables.validation: Repeated timing, hash verification and rights manifest review.
achievables.independentCrossCheck: Second inference process and artifact hash check.
achievables.remainingUncertainty: CES-S is research-only; commercial deployment rights are not established. CPU feasibility is demonstrated.

achievables.objective: Score already-consumed FLUX.1 diagnostics only after candidate freeze to characterize provider/runtime shift.
achievables.hypothesis: CES-S behavior may differ between public and Cloudflare FLUX.1, preserving material domain risk.
achievables.successCondition: Separate post-hoc distributions are reported without tuning or reserve contamination.
achievables.falsificationCondition: Any candidate/threshold is changed after diagnostic exposure or FLUX.2 is accessed.
achievables.experiment: Run frozen CES-E/CES-S and SAFE-A diagnostics after all independent confirmation is sealed.
achievables.validation: No fitting, no threshold changes, no FLUX.2 access.
achievables.remainingUncertainty: The public/provider shift remains material and unexplained; the diagnostic was not used for fitting or threshold changes.

achievables.objective: Refine a research-only evidence-grade/originals-first input boundary from CES-E and CES-S results.
achievables.hypothesis: A conservative applicability boundary can preserve positive evidence without converting degraded inputs into human claims.
achievables.successCondition: Bounded eligible/limited/unsupported rates and reason-coded criteria are reported without production mutation.
achievables.falsificationCondition: No useful boundary exists or the policy would imply unsupported authenticity claims.
achievables.experiment: Apply frozen CES-E states to native JPEG, re-encoded JPEG, PNG, JPEG-to-PNG and compound cases.
achievables.validation: Held-out source-family application and explicit reliable/probabilistic/unknowable distinctions.
achievables.independentCrossCheck: Second policy evaluator and artifact replay.
achievables.remainingUncertainty: Customer traffic composition is not represented by this bounded research corpus; production upload policy remains unchanged.

achievables.objective: Run focused and historical validation, prove deterministic replay, preserve SAFE-A/FLUX.2/production boundaries and record baseline failures.
achievables.hypothesis: The research package can be tested without weakening previous contracts.
achievables.successCondition: All applicable tests/checks pass or unchanged baseline failures are explicitly isolated; all zero-access assertions hold.
achievables.falsificationCondition: Leakage, hash, secret, production, SAFE-A or FLUX.2 control failure.
achievables.experiment: Run WP007K, WP007J-R1, WP007J/I/H and repository suites plus syntax/schema/privacy checks.
achievables.validation: Git diff, tests, typecheck, architecture, native scope, provider scans and deterministic reruns.
achievables.independentCrossCheck: Second-run hashes and local/remote PR metadata.
achievables.remainingUncertainty: Two unchanged historical repository checks remain red as documented; no WP007K control or scientific result is invalidated.

achievables.objective: Publish a dedicated unmerged WP007K PR and complete the 110% self-audit.
achievables.hypothesis: The full scientific result can be reviewed independently without merging or production authorization.
achievables.successCondition: PR open/unmerged from exact parent, final report and ledger show every achievable at 110% or a justified blocker.
achievables.falsificationCondition: PR lineage mismatch, unreviewed artifact, or production/SAFE-A/FLUX.2 mutation.
achievables.experiment: Commit sanitized code/results, push branch and open PR.
achievables.validation: GitHub PR state, head/base SHA, diff review and self-audit table.
achievables.independentCrossCheck: GitHub metadata versus local commit and final manifest.
